title: אבא שאול בן אמא מרים

paragraphs: Abba Shaul ben Imma Miriam. The halakhah follows him [Warsaw digital text במותו; the checked Yuhasin reads כמותו]. A tanna of a baraita, Ha-Kotev (Yuhasin there). Ketubbot 87a: Rav Nahman said that Shmuel said in Abba Shaul ben Imma Miriam's name; Shmuel said that the halakhah follows him. See Tosafot, Ketubbot 44a.
